title: Playwright Dungeon Crawl: a quick tour

steps.say: Playwright Dungeon Crawl: learn Playwright by clearing a dungeon, one floor at a time.
Every floor has a scroll to read, a riddle, and a trap room only a test can beat.
Floor 1's scroll gets you set up, step by step.
Then you warm up on the training dummy.
Poke it yourself first. Your first test will do the same.
Then it's on to the Welcome Matt, a trap room built for Playwright, not your mouse.
Knock with Playwright and the door gives up its treasure flag.
Clear all seven floors to earn a Certificate of Survival anyone can verify.
